title: Flame Core Miner
description: It dramatically improves the efficiency of your adventures by handling mining and smelting simultaneously.
body:
Flame Core Miner is a mod that adds a special pickaxe that automatically smelts mined ore.
It dramatically improves the efficiency of your adventures by handling mining and smelting simultaneously.
Additionally, it has the effect of burning opponents when.
[Recipe]
     
https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/15e0a06116612ea693cbf9d32154ea67d323eefc.png

*Note*
***Applying Silk Touch disables the ore smelting function** (to prevent duplication).

**The automatic smelting function is limited to vanilla ores.** (It will not work on ores from other mods.)!
